newsitem.title: CHINA: China Q1 fixed asset investment up 13.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Q1 fixed asset investment up 13.9 pct.

text.p: China's first quarter fixed asset investment rose a year-on-year 13.9 percent, the State Statistical Bureau said on Friday.
The State Statistical Bureau said that total fixed asset investment for the period was 147.8 billion yuan ($17.8 billion).
Fixed asset investment is closely watched by economists in China as it seen as a measure of longer term demand for credit.
Many economists have been pressing for a relaxation in controls on fixed asset investment following the government's recent successes in keeping inflation under control.
The bureau reported that consumer price inflation in the first quarter was 5.2 percent and the rate for March was four percent. Benchmark retail price inflation during the quarter was 2.6 percent.
It said that both of the key measurements of inflation during the first quarter showed the lowest rise for the period since 1992.
